system_description.narrative_title: Hot October CPI, Rising Yields and a Hawkish Fed Pivot
system_description.narrative_summary: Across the news window a single dominant story emerges: hotter-than-expected October inflation has reignited expectations of more aggressive central-bank action, pushing US Treasury yields toward 5% and triggering broad market repricing. Fed officials' comments about potential additional hikes (including the possibility of a half-point) are amplifying a feedback loop where rising yields weigh on equities, commodities (gold) and global currencies, and spill over into credit conditions and investor sentiment worldwide.
system_description.scope: US October CPI surprise, Fed communications and rate-expectations, US Treasury yield moves (notably the 10-year), global bond and FX responses, equity and commodity market reactions, and resulting investor sentiment and credit/friction effects.
system_description.super_system: Global macro-financial system (monetary policy, cross-border capital flows, global trade and commodity markets).
adjacent_subsystems: UK fiscal and political developments (devolution, public utilities, domestic inflation/policy)
Energy and commodity markets (oil, gold and their price feedback to inflation and sentiment)
Technology/AI equity cycle and corporate financing (AI sell-offs, risk appetite, bank lending)
evidence_headlines: 10-year Treasury yield races back to 5% as inflation data, Waller comments drive rate hike expectations
US consumer prices increase strongly for third straight month in October
Stocks fall as the 10-year Treasury yield reclaims 5%
Fed's Waller plans to support at least a quarter-point rate hike in December
Instant view: Hot October inflation report rattles markets
Gold falls nearly 3% as CPI tops forecasts, lifting dollar and yields

variables.name: Consumer price inflation rate
variables.description: The percentage change in a broad consumer price index over a 12-month period, capturing headline inflation momentum.

variables.name: Inflation surprise magnitude
variables.description: The deviation between reported consumer inflation and prevailing market or consensus expectations measured for a reporting period.

variables.name: Policy interest-rate level
variables.description: The prevailing short-term policy interest rate set by the monetary authority as the benchmark for short-term funding costs.

variables.name: Monetary policy expectations
variables.description: The market-implied expected path and timing of future policy-rate adjustments formed by investors and analysts.

variables.name: Ten-year government bond yield
variables.description: The nominal market yield on a sovereign 10-year benchmark bond reflecting medium-term funding costs and discounting of future rates.

variables.name: Government bond term premium
variables.description: The component of long-term government yields that compensates investors for duration, liquidity risk and uncertainty about future rates.

variables.name: Bond market liquidity
variables.description: The ease with which large fixed-income positions can be traded without materially moving prices, measured by bid-ask spreads and market depth.

variables.name: Equity market price level
variables.description: Aggregate price level of major equity markets measured by broad indices, summarizing equity valuations and wealth effects.

variables.name: Equity market implied volatility
variables.description: Market-implied near-term volatility of equity prices derived from option prices, reflecting uncertainty and hedging demand.

variables.name: Commodity price index
variables.description: A weighted index of major commodity prices (including energy and industrial metals) summarizing input-cost pressures for the economy.

variables.name: Precious metal price level
variables.description: Spot price level of major precious metals, serving as a store-of-value and inflation/risk hedge indicator.

variables.name: Broad currency strength index
variables.description: The value of a major currency measured against a trade-weighted basket of other currencies, indicating relative external competitiveness and safe-haven flows.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flow rate
variables.description: Net rate of international portfolio and other financial capital moving into or out of a market or jurisdiction per period.

variables.name: Investor sentiment
variables.description: Aggregate market risk appetite and confidence among investors, summarizing willingness to take on risk and marginal demand for risky assets.

variables.name: Corporate credit spread
variables.description: The average yield differential between corporate bond yields and comparable sovereign yields, reflecting default and liquidity premia.

variables.name: Private sector debt stock
variables.description: Outstanding stock of household and non-financial corporate debt measured in nominal terms or as a share of GDP, indicating leverage and balance-sheet vulnerability.

catalysts.title: FOMC December interest-rate decision
catalysts.description: Federal Reserve's December meeting where officials may announce another rate increase (size and pace disputed).
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines: Fed officials (Waller, others) signal likely December hike and even half-point options.

catalysts.title: US November CPI release
catalysts.description: The next US consumer-price report for November, a key input for Fed decisions and market pricing.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines flag upcoming key CPI prints and uncertainty after hot October inflation.

catalysts.title: Sustained 10-year UST around/above 5%
catalysts.description: The 10-year Treasury yield remaining at or above ~5%, extending recent sell-off and repricing of duration risk.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 10-year yield reclaims 5%, tops 5% as inflation fuels rate expectations and market sell-off.

catalysts.title: Sustained hawkish Fed rhetoric and potential acceleration of hikes
catalysts.description: Ongoing push from multiple Fed officials that could accelerate the tightening path and lift market rate expectations.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple Fed speakers (Waller, Logan, Goolsbee) open door to larger or quicker hikes after hot CPI.

catalysts.title: Rising global wholesale inflation
catalysts.description: Acceleration in producer and wholesale inflation (e.g., Japan, China) that can feed through to consumer inflation and rates.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: Japan PPI surges, China producer inflation accelerates — upstream pressures remain elevated.

catalysts.title: Holiday spending raises consumer debt
catalysts.description: Seasonal increase in spending and record credit-card balances that raise private-sector leverage and potential stress.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: record credit-card debt and warnings holiday credit-card bills will rise.

catalysts.title: Elevated bond-market volatility and liquidity strain
catalysts.description: Ongoing sell-offs and volatility in Treasuries that may reduce market depth and widen risk premia.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: Treasury sell-off, commentary on bond market taking matters into its own hands and volatility spikes.

catalysts.title: Risk of further Japanese FX intervention
catalysts.description: Following a large one-day intervention, authorities may act again to stabilize the yen, affecting global flows and FX.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: Japan spent a record $50bn in a single day to bolster the yen, implying further intervention risk.
